The '''Rivoria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] known as [[Rivorian grain-bandit]]s.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rivoria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square J-19.<ref name="TEA" />
